pins.head: GIVE EACH CORNER A JOB
pins.title: Studio Apartment Layout: Give Every Corner One Job and Stick to It
pins.desc: A studio feels chaotic when the same square metre is a bedroom at night, an office at noon and a dining room at seven. Decide what each corner is for, then let the furniture say it: a shelf unit with its back to the bed, a rug that ends where the sitting area ends, a lamp that only lights the desk. Nothing is built, and the room still reads as rooms. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLiving #ApartmentLayout
pins.alt: A studio flat with a teal bed behind an open cube shelf used as a divider, a dark teal sofa with a coral throw on a patterned rug, and a small desk with a lamp against the far wall.

pins.head: CLEAR THE BENCH, THEN POUR
pins.sub: Setting Up Before the Resin Opens
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Workstation: Everything in Reach Before the Bottles Open
pins.desc: Once the two parts are mixed you have minutes, and you will not have a free hand. Lay a silicone mat down, stand the cups and stirrers where your dominant hand falls, put the gloves on before you touch anything, and clear the rest of the bench so there is nowhere for a drip to land that matters. Setting up is the part that decides how the pour goes. Contains affiliate links. #ResinCrafts #CraftRoom #EpoxyResin
pins.alt: A dark silicone work mat on a pale bench holding two clear mixing cups, a white resin bottle and a pair of blue gloves, with a curtained window behind.

pins.head: ONE PATCH, ONE NIGHT
pins.title: Acne Patches: Price the Box by the Night, Not by the Count
pins.desc: A patch is a single-use item, so the honest number is what one night costs you. Divide the box price by the patches you would actually reach for, ignore the sizes you will never use, and compare two boxes on that figure. A cheap box of the wrong sizes is more expensive than a dearer one you finish. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRoutine #AcnePatches #BathroomRefills
pins.alt: A bright bathroom counter beside the window with a shallow cream dish, a small potted plant and folded white towels on the shelf behind.

pins.head: TAME THE CABLE NEST
pins.sub: Getting the Wires Off the Floor
pins.title: Small Home Office: Get the Cables Off the Floor and Into One Box
pins.desc: Loose cables are why a small desk never looks finished and why cleaning under it is a chore. Put the power strip in a lidded box, run everything to that one point, and clip the slack to the underside of the desk so nothing touches the floor. The cost is one box and twenty minutes, and the desk can be moved without untangling anything. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #CableManagement #DeskSetup
pins.alt: A wood desk by a tall window with a monitor on a riser, a dark lamp and a teal chair, and a white cable box on the floor underneath gathering the wires.

pins.head: REMOVABLE COMES OFF CLEAN
pins.title: Removable Matte Vinyl: For Walls, Windows and Anything You Rent
pins.desc: Permanent vinyl is the wrong choice on a rented wall, a window or a jar you will want back. Removable film holds for years indoors and peels away without taking paint or leaving a ring of adhesive. Keep one roll of each on the bench and decide by the surface rather than by whichever roll is nearer. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #RemovableVinyl #CricutProjects
pins.alt: Two rolls of matte craft vinyl, one coral and one cream, lying on a pale workbench beside a weeding hook and a cut leaf decal on a card.

pins.head: NOTHING GOES IN THE WALL
pins.sub: Bathroom Storage a Landlord Cannot See
pins.title: Rented Bathroom Storage With No Drilling and No Marks to Fill
pins.desc: Tile is the worst surface to put a hole in and the one most rented bathrooms are covered with. A rolling cart stands on the floor, a shelf sits on the cistern, over-the-door hooks carry the towels and tension fittings take the rest. Everything comes out on the last day of the lease and nothing needs filling. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #BathroomStorage #NoDrill
pins.alt: A narrow white rolling cart holding folded teal towels, spare rolls and two pump bottles, standing on tiled floor beside a toilet with a wooden seat, with woven baskets on the shelf above.

pins.head: TWO THIN COATS OF PRIMER
pins.title: Priming Miniatures: Two Thin Coats Beat One Heavy One Every Time
pins.desc: A thick coat of primer fills the fine lines that the model was cast for, and no amount of careful painting brings them back. Thin the primer, lay it on in two passes with the model turned between them, and let the first dry properly before the second. The surface you want is matte and slightly toothy, not glossy and not fuzzy. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #Wargaming #HobbyPainting
pins.alt: Three unpainted metal miniatures standing on cork bases on a dark cutting mat, with two fine brushes, a small terracotta pot and a glass jar on the bench beside them.

pins.head: HANG A SHELF IN THE RAIL
pins.sub: Using the Dead Air Under the Clothes
pins.title: Tiny Closet Storage: Hang the Shelves From the Rail You Already Have
pins.desc: Half the height of a small closet is empty air under the short clothes. A fabric organizer that hangs from the same rail turns that into four shelves for jumpers and folded things, and it needs no fixings at all. Keep the long coats together at one end so the hanging unit has a clean column to itself. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #SmallCloset #RenterHacks
pins.alt: An open closet with a white hanging fabric organizer of folded coral and teal jumpers beside a rail of shirts, and clear stackable shoe boxes on the floor below.

pins.head: ORDER BEFORE THE BAG ENDS
pins.title: Coffee Subscriptions: Set the Interval to the Bag You Actually Finish
pins.desc: Most coffee subscriptions default to a month because it is a tidy number, not because it matches how fast you drink. Time one bag from opening to empty, add a few days so the next arrives before you run out, and set that as the interval. Too frequent and beans go stale in the cupboard; too slow and you buy a stopgap bag at the corner shop. Contains affiliate links. #CoffeeLovers #WholeBeanCoffee #KitchenRefills
pins.alt: A tall kraft coffee bag standing on a pale wood counter with roasted beans scattered in front of it and a small notepad propped up beside it.

pins.head: TENSION RODS, NO SCREWS
pins.title: Renter Storage: A Tension Rod Turns an Alcove Into a Wardrobe
pins.desc: An alcove with nothing in it is the most wasted space in a rented flat, and a tension rod fills it for the price of a sandwich. Measure the clear span at the height you want, buy a rod whose range sits in the middle of that number rather than at its limit, and hang bags and coats from it. Baskets underneath finish the column. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #TensionRod #SmallSpaceStorage
pins.alt: Tote bags and a teal garment hanging from a rod under a white shelf in a shallow alcove, with a woven basket and a slim white cart on the floor beneath and a trailing plant above.

pins.head: STAND THE TUBES UPRIGHT
pins.title: Sensitivity Toothpaste in a Three Pack: Enough to Stop Switching Back
pins.desc: Toothpaste for sensitive teeth is only worth buying if you use it long enough to notice, which a single tube rarely lasts. A three pack covers a proper run, and standing the spares upright in a drawer divider means you can see at a glance when the last one is due. Check the price per ounce against a single tube before you commit. Contains affiliate links. #ToothpasteStorage #SensitiveTeeth #BathroomDrawer
pins.alt: Four white toothpaste tubes standing upright in a clear divider bin inside an open bamboo drawer, with spare toothbrush heads in the bin beside them.

pins.head: BUILD AROUND THE PIPES
pins.sub: Under the Sink Without Fighting the Plumbing
pins.title: Under-Sink Organization: Work Around the Pipes Instead of Against Them
pins.desc: The cupboard under a sink is the one place a flat shelf never fits, because the trap sits right in the middle of it. An expandable two-tier unit steps over the pipework and leaves the floor of the cupboard for the bottles that stand tall. Put a wipeable liner down first, because the slow leak you do not know about starts there. Contains affiliate links. #UnderSinkStorage #KitchenOrganization #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: An open under-sink cupboard with teal doors showing the pipework, a spray bottle and two pale storage bins on a liner covering the cupboard floor.
